$comment: Drawn canopy over the woodland wash, the way a pictorial map builds a forest: a flat tint underneath, individual trees stamped on top. Positions come from pipeline/scatter.py and are DECORATIVE - OpenStreetMap has only 6 individual trees for this estate, so these are generated, not surveyed.
$comment_draw_order: symbol-sort-key uses the `order` property, which scatter.py assigns north-to-south, so nearer canopies overlap those behind them instead of sorting arbitrarily.
$comment_zoom: Hidden below z15 - three thousand symbols at estate zoom is noise, and the woodland wash already reads as forest at that scale.
label: Trees
